blocks.title: Let's Sing!
blocks.body: Are you ready to sing Johny Johny Yes Papa? It is one of the most fun songs!

blocks.title: Johny Johny Yes Papa
blocks.content:
Johny Johny!
Yes Papa?
Eating sugar?
No Papa!

blocks.title: For Parents & Teachers
blocks.content: Encourage the child to do the hand actions while singing this rhyme to build motor skills.
